name: Shiobara Yuriko
source:
Likes: [url=/c33356]Onee-sama[/url]
Dislikes: Everything that gets in the way of her onee-sama

[url=/c35512]Seiji's[/url] classmate who is completely attached to Sena, calling her "onee-sama" and believing to have been connected to her by a red string of fate. She believes their bond is absolute and cannot be broken by no means.
